tex_content.html:
↗ lem:curvature-bound-compact-subset ↗ claim:curvature-bound-outside-large-ball

Any complete non-negative-curvature limit flow on $(-T,0]$, $T<\infty $, locally bounded in time, has uniformly bounded scalar curvature on $B(x_\infty ,0,A)\times (-T,0]$ for every $A<\infty $.
Proof

↗ lem:curvature-bound-compact-subset ↗ claim:curvature-bound-outside-large-ball ↗ scalarevol \sketch If the limit is compact, $\min R$ is controlled by Proposition scalarevol and Lemma 2. If noncompact, first use the preceding exterior bound on the closure of a large ball, then apply the compact-subset lemma to each larger ball.

□
